name: CodeRabbit Verify
desc: Sandbox that starts your app and clicks through the change.
desc_zh: 把应用跑起来、像用户一样点一遍改动的沙箱。
solves: A green diff still ships a broken feature; the app is started in an isolated sandbox and exercised before the pull request merges.
solves_zh: diff 全绿也照样会上线一个坏掉的功能；合并前应用会在隔离沙箱里被真实操作一遍。
best_for: Nobody has time to click through every pull request by hand before merging.
best_for_zh: 没人有时间在合并前逐个 Pull Request 手工点一遍。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — docs.coderabbit.ai/changelog directory）。 Newest of four CodeRabbit surfaces added in the window. 首次公开日期来源：https://docs.coderabbit.ai/changelog
